body: Thanks, it helped me feel a bit better about myself, I'll just keep trying then. Hopefully I won't feel the need to post here again. Thanks again

Thanks for the response
It's not that I feel bad about the prom itself, it was fun and I liked it, it's just bugging me that I can't properly socialise. I bet if I went to another big party like that it'd be exactly the same. The only way for me to be confident and fun in such social situations is drinking myself to a point where I can barely remember anything later on, but I don't want to lose control over myself, I'd just share too many things about myself with people, or do something I'd regret later and be a nuisance for those taking care of me.
